message: Selector ".t::before" puts text directly inside <table>, which can't hold it, so it was skipped
hint: Browsers move such text out of the table, so it would land in the wrong place; put the text in a cell, or put the pseudo-element on the <td>.

message: Selector ".t tr::after" puts text directly inside <tr>, which can't hold it, so it was skipped
hint: Browsers move such text out of the table, so it would land in the wrong place; put the text in a cell, or put the pseudo-element on the <td>.
